why: वृष॑भ्यां is the instrumental dual of वृषन् (with the two bulls = हरिभ्यां), correct form.
वृष॑भिः is the instrumental plural of वृषन्, correct in 'आगत्या वृषभिः सुतम्'.
वृष॑णः is the nominative plural of वृषन्, agreeing with ऋजुमुष्कान्... शुक्राँश्च; fine.
वृष॑ण is वृषणः with visarga dropped before ऋ (ऋजुमुष्काः), regular sandhi.
सुम॒ती is the Vedic instrumental of सुमति (with goodwill), not the accusative; fine.
वयो॒धाः nominative of वयोधा (life-giving), an epithet of वृषा; correct.
क॒थायं is कथा + अयं in sandhi (how does this one...), correct.
मदे॑न is the instrumental of मद (with exhilaration), fine.
वयो॒धै is the dative of वयोधा, object of अह्वयेतां; correct.
म॒घवा॑नः is the nominative plural subject of सचन्ताम्; correct.
वृष॒भा is वृषभाः with visarga lost before प्र, subject of प्र ब्रुवन्ति; fine.
The final anudatta on वी॒तये॒ is right because the next word वायो॑ begins a pada and carries udatta.
जरि॒तुः is the genitive of जरितृ (the singer's sacrifice), correct.
व॑हति is a normal 3rd singular present; the line is fine.
जरि॒त्र उ॒त is जरित्रे + उत with regular sandhi (e + u -> a u).
ओज॑से is the dative (bows for strength), correct.
मद॑श्च is मदः + च, correct sandhi.
मद॑न्तं is the accusative participle agreeing with मेळिं; fine.
मद॑था is the 2nd plural with Vedic lengthening (मदथ), fine.
धारा॑म् is the accusative in the simile 'अयसो न धाराम्', correct.
वृत्र॒हं is the neuter accusative of the a-stem वृत्रह- agreeing with शवः; correct.
उत्त॑रा is the feminine nominative agreeing with द्यौः; correct.
The final anudatta on वाज॑सातौ॒ is right before the accented relative यं; fine.
पिब॑त is the 2nd plural imperative addressed to the मरुतः; correct.
पिब॑न्ति is the 3rd plural with गावः as subject; correct.
धाम॑हे is the 1st plural middle (we may obtain), correct.
स॒जोष॑स is सजोषसः with visarga lost before आ (आदित्यैः) and before ऋ (ऋभवः); regular sandhi.
वरु॑ण॒स्ते is वरुणः + ते, correct sandhi.
रोदसी is an unaccented mid-pada vocative, so svarita on रो after नू and anudatta on सी before अहि॑ना are consistent.
गृण॒त उ॒र्व्यू॑तिः is गृणते + उर्व्यूतिः with regular sandhi (e + u -> a u).
पृत॑ना॒: is the accusative plural पृतनाः, object of व्यास; correct.
पुन॑र्नः is पुनः + नः, correct sandhi.
सिन्धु॑भिः instrumental plural parallel to सप्तमातृभिः; correct.
The final anudatta on राध॑से॒ is right before udatta तु of तुवि॑ष्मान्; fine.
सुन्व॒त आ is सुन्वते + आ with regular sandhi; the digit १ in मक्ष्वि१त्था is svara notation.
दक्षि॑ण उ॒त is दक्षिणः + उत with visarga dropped; correct.
दक्षि॑णाया अयो॒जि is दक्षिणायाः + अयोजि with visarga dropped; correct.
दक्षि॑णायाः is the genitive (son of Dakshina); the spaced avagraha is the edition's style.
The final anudatta on ह॑वामहे॒ is right before udatta व of वरु॑णं; fine.
रथा॑य dative parallel to अर्वते; correct.
मर्त्या॑सः is the Vedic nominative plural (mortals who saw); correct.
मर्त्या॑सो is मर्त्यासः with sandhi before निषङ्गिणः; correct.
अपि॑बो ह is अपिबः + ह (you drank), correct.
सद॑न ऋ॒तस्य॑ is सदने + ऋतस्य with regular sandhi; correct.
सद॑सो is the ablative सदसः (waking from the seat of ऋत); correct.
गोम॑न्तं is the accusative agreeing with रयिं; correct.
पर॒मा अ॑स्य is परमाः + अस्य with visarga dropped; correct.
गोम॑तो is गोमतः with sandhi before द (of the cow-rich enclosure); correct.
पर॒मो द॒दार॑ is परमः + ददार, correct sandhi.
गोम॑घा is गोमघाः before ज, and the same word appears in the preceding verse; correct.
सद॑नेषु is the locative plural (sits in the seats of Mitra); correct.
रथा॑सः is the Vedic nominative plural agreeing with बहवः; correct.
Ordinary line; words, sandhi and marks are regular.
